title: Seedance Video Watermark Removal: Current Support and Workflow
description: Learn what the Seedance Watermark Remover MVP supports today and how extracted frames fit the future video-processing roadmap.
heading: A clear path from extracted frames to future video support
intro: The current MVP does not accept MP4 or MOV files. It can process an authorized still frame while the provider abstraction remains ready for a dedicated video backend.

process.heading: Test one Seedance video frame while direct video support is in development

steps.title: Export a representative frame
steps.description: Save an authorized frame from the video as JPG, PNG, or WebP; MP4 and MOV uploads are not supported.

steps.title: Upload the still image
steps.description: Sign in and upload the exported frame, no larger than 10 MB, through the private image workflow.

steps.title: Evaluate only the frame result
steps.description: Review the returned still-image preview without assuming that motion, audio, timing, or the full video was processed.

faq.heading: Current limits for Seedance video watermark workflows

items.question: Which video formats are supported?
items.answer: None yet. Direct video upload is not implemented.

items.question: Can I upload a frame from a Seedance video?
items.answer: Yes, if it is JPG, PNG, or WebP, no larger than 10 MB, and you own or may edit the source.

items.question: Will audio or motion be preserved?
items.answer: The current image workflow does not process video, audio, timing, or motion.
